title: Domain Registrations: Billing of New Registrations and Inbound Transfers
content:
## Billing desk tariff note — new registrations and inbound transfers of Domain Registrations

### 1. New registration

A new registration is billed at the TLD's registration price for the first year plus the TLD's renewal price for each additional year, plus the TLD's ICANN fee for every year registered. The registration-price component and the additional-year component of a paid new registration are reduced together by the domain registration discount percentage that the account charter, Harborline Customer Accounts, sets for the customer's account tier; that reduced amount is rounded half up to the cent, and the ICANN fee for every registered year is then added undiscounted.

The number of years must be at least the TLD's minimum registration years, and the resulting expiry date may lie no more than the TLD's maximum registration years after the registration date.

### 2. Inbound transfer

An inbound transfer is billed once at the TLD's transfer-in price plus one year's ICANN fee. Transfers are never discounted.

### 3. Registration covered by a hosting plan's free domain

A registration covered by a hosting plan's free-domain entitlement under the free-domain-with-hosting terms is billed at zero, with payment method bundle credit, for the TLD's free-with-hosting years; any further years are billed at the renewal price plus the ICANN fee. Bundled lines are never discounted.

### 4. Rounding and the ICANN fee

All amounts are rounded half up to the cent. The ICANN fee is never discounted.

### 5. Presence requirement of the registrant

An order whose registrant declares that they meet the presence requirement of the TLD may be placed, and an order whose registrant cannot declare a United States nexus category for .us or a Canadian Presence Requirements category for .ca is not placed. This condition rests on the registrant's own declaration, made before the order is placed, for the customer whose order it is.

### 6. When a purchase is billed

Purchase charges are billed when the order is placed, while the holding is still pending. The status checked is that of the holding the order creates, read from the system record before the charge.

### Hypothetical example (figures invented for illustration, not any TLD's prices)

A three-year new registration on a hypothetical TLD with a registration price of USD 30.00, a renewal price of USD 40.00 and an ICANN fee of USD 0.20, for an account tier whose domain registration discount percentage is 10 per cent: the first year and two additional years come to USD 110.00; reduced by 10 per cent that is USD 99.00; the ICANN fee for three years, USD 0.60, is added, giving USD 99.60. An inbound transfer on the same hypothetical TLD with a transfer-in price of USD 36.00 is billed USD 36.20, with no discount.
